SDCard Frame Count

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x24
Size:
0x4
Source:
adc_acquisition_reg_definition.rdl

Description

Number of frames the ADC-fill side may dispatch to the HW copy engine in ACQ_SDCARD mode before it stops raising Fx_FULL, independent of how long dispatched jobs take to physically finish. Each frame is written with its own CMD24 (WRITE_BLOCK); this is the only place the total frame count is configured.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:0] FRAME_COUNT w 0x0 Frame Count

Field Descriptions

FRAME_COUNT - Frame Count

Target frame count for the current SDCard capture (N)
